content.text: Merge ctest_geometry_nonuniform into the other unit tests. Unit tests should only have names of related modules

I’ll locate `ctest_geometry_nonuniform`, move its cases into the relevant module tests, and update the build targets. I’m using the repository’s directory, naming, code style, and test/build skills for this change.

The ten cases cover three modules: `mirror_grid_gen`, `gk_geometry_mapc2p`, and `gk_geometry_tok`. I’ll move them into those existing test files and preserve all ten cases. The Makefile discovers tests automatically, so removing the old source also removes it from the test suite.

const patch = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('gyrokinetic/unit')
source = (root / 'ctest_geometry_nonuniform.c').read_text()

def section(start, end):
    return source[source.index(start):source.index(end)]

common = section('struct quadratic_map_ctx {', 'static void check_mirror_mapping(')
mirror = section('static void check_mirror_mapping(', 'static void curved_cartesian_map(')
mirror += section('static void test_mirror_all_maps(', 'TEST_LIST = {')
cartesian = section('static void curved_cartesian_map(', 'static void compare_nodes(')
compare = section('static void compare_nodes(', 'static void check_geometry_partitions(')
partitions = section('static void check_geometry_partitions(', 'static void test_mapc2p_partitions(')

def replace_once(text, old, new):
    assert text.count(old) == 1, old
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)

mapc2p = replace_once(partitions, 'static void check_geometry_partitions(bool tokamak, bool analytic)', 'static void test_mapc2p_partitions(void)')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'analytic ? GKYL_PMAP_USER_INPUT_W_DERIVATIVE : GKYL_PMAP_USER_INPUT', 'GKYL_PMAP_USER_INPUT')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'tokamak ? 0 : quadratic_map', 'quadratic_map')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'tokamak ? GKYL_GEOMETRY_TOKAMAK : GKYL_GEOMETRY_MAPC2P', 'GKYL_GEOMETRY_MAPC2P')
start = mapc2p.index('    .efit_info =')
end = mapc2p.index('    .grid = grid,', start)
mapc2p = mapc2p[:start] + mapc2p[end:]
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'tokamak ? gkyl_gk_geometry_tok_new(&inp) :\n                                       gkyl_gk_geometry_mapc2p_new(&inp)', 'gkyl_gk_geometry_mapc2p_new(&inp)')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'tokamak ? gkyl_gk_geometry_tok_new(&inp) :\n                                             gkyl_gk_geometry_mapc2p_new(&inp)', 'gkyl_gk_geometry_mapc2p_new(&inp)')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'slope / (tokamak ? pi : 1.0)', 'slope')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, 'tokamak ? 0.0 : 0.2 / pow', '0.2 / pow')
mapc2p = replace_once(mapc2p, '// Independent axial derivative and physical B projection in a\n          // Curved Cartesian map or a straight cylinder.', '// Independent axial derivative and curl in a curved Cartesian map.')
assert 'tokamak' not in mapc2p

tokamak = replace_once(partitions, 'static void check_geometry_partitions(bool tokamak, bool analytic)', 'static void check_tokamak_partitions(bool analytic)')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, 'tokamak ? 0 : quadratic_map', '0')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, 'tokamak ? GKYL_GEOMETRY_TOKAMAK : GKYL_GEOMETRY_MAPC2P', 'GKYL_GEOMETRY_TOKAMAK')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, '    .mapc2p = curved_cartesian_map,\n    .bfield_func = curved_field,\n', '')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, 'tokamak ? gkyl_gk_geometry_tok_new(&inp) :\n                                       gkyl_gk_geometry_mapc2p_new(&inp)', 'gkyl_gk_geometry_tok_new(&inp)')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, 'tokamak ? gkyl_gk_geometry_tok_new(&inp) :\n                                             gkyl_gk_geometry_mapc2p_new(&inp)', 'gkyl_gk_geometry_tok_new(&inp)')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, 'slope / (tokamak ? pi : 1.0)', 'slope / pi')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, '            double zphys;\n            quadratic_map(0.0, &zcomp, &zphys, &maps[2]);\n            double curl_y = tokamak ? 0.0 : 0.2 / pow(1.0 + 0.04 * zphys * zphys, 1.5);\n', '')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, 'fabs(curl[dim] - (dim == 1 ? curl_y : 0.0))', 'fabs(curl[dim])')
tokamak = replace_once(tokamak, '// Independent axial derivative and physical B projection in a\n          // Curved Cartesian map or a straight cylinder.', '// Independent axial derivative and vanishing curl in a straight cylinder.')
tokamak += section('static void test_tokamak_partitions_numeric(', 'static void test_mirror_all_maps(').replace('check_geometry_partitions(true, ', 'check_tokamak_partitions(')
assert 'GKYL_GEOMETRY_MAPC2P' not in tokamak

additions = {
    'ctest_mirror_grid_gen.c': common + mirror,
    'ctest_gk_geometry_mapc2p.c': common + cartesian + compare + mapc2p,
    'ctest_gk_geometry_tok.c': common + compare + tokamak,
}
registrations = {
    'ctest_mirror_grid_gen.c': ['mirror_all_maps', 'mirror_nonuniform_axis', 'mirror_identity', 'mirror_affine', 'mirror_nonlinear_numeric', 'mirror_nonlinear_analytic', 'mirror_sqrt_psi'],
    'ctest_gk_geometry_mapc2p.c': ['mapc2p_partitions'],
    'ctest_gk_geometry_tok.c': ['tokamak_partitions_numeric', 'tokamak_partitions_analytic'],
}
print('*** Begin Patch')
for filename, addition in additions.items():
    path = root / filename
    original = path.read_text()
    assert original.count('TEST_LIST = {') == 1
    print(f'*** Update File: {path}')
    if filename == 'ctest_mirror_grid_gen.c':
        print('@@\n #include <acutest.h>\n+#include <math.h>\n #include <stdint.h>')
        print('@@\n #include <gkyl_alloc.h>\n+#include <gkyl_array.h>\n #include <gkyl_array_rio.h>')
    else:
        print('@@\n #include <math.h>\n+#include <stdint.h>\n #include <stdio.h>')
    print('@@')
    for line in addition.splitlines():
        print('+' + line)
    print(' TEST_LIST = {')
    for name in registrations[filename]:
        print(f'+  {{"{name}", test_{name}}},')
print('*** Delete File: gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_geometry_nonuniform.c')
print('*** End Patch')
PY",
  max_output_tokens:18000
});
if (patch.exit_code !== 0) { text(patch); exit(); }
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch.output));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"clang-format -i gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_mirror_grid_gen.c gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_gk_geometry_mapc2p.c gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_gk_geometry_tok.c && git diff --stat && git diff --check",max_output_tokens:3000}));

const r = await Promise.allSettled([
  tools.write_stdin({session_id:66332,chars:"",yield_time_ms:1000,max_output_tokens:3000}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import re
import subprocess

root = Path('gyrokinetic/unit')
files = ['ctest_mirror_grid_gen.c', 'ctest_gk_geometry_mapc2p.c', 'ctest_gk_geometry_tok.c']
def names(text):
    return re.findall(r'\{"([^"]+)",\s*test_\w+\}', text.split('TEST_LIST = {', 1)[1])
old = names(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_geometry_nonuniform.c'], text=True))
added = []
for filename in files:
    before = names(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{root / filename}'], text=True))
    after = names((root / filename).read_text())
    assert all(after.count(name) == 1 for name in before)
    new = [name for name in after if name not in before]
    added.extend(new)
    print(f'{filename}: retained {len(before)} existing cases; added {len(new)} moved cases')
assert Counter(added) == Counter(old)
assert not (root / 'ctest_geometry_nonuniform.c').exists()
print('All 10 cases preserved exactly once; removed standalone source.')
PY
clang-format --dry-run --Werror gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_mirror_grid_gen.c gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_gk_geometry_mapc2p.c gyrokinetic/unit/ctest_gk_geometry_tok.c
git diff --check",max_output_tokens:2200})
